title: Biofilm microbiome and isolated Sphaerotilus montanus (strain KMKE) gene sequences from streams receiving organic airport deicer runoff
description: Heterotrophic biofilm growths were monitored in sites upstream and downstream of Milwaukee Mitchell International Airport, in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, during and surrounding the 2009-2010 and 2010-2011 deicing seasons. Biofilms were assessed through both field surveys and genetic investigations, and responses to environmental factors were characterized. A new strain of Sphaerotilus montanus (strain KMKE) was isolated and demonstrated growth on deicer compounds. This BioProject contains the genetic data used in the journal article: Advanced biofilm analysis in streams receiving organic deicer runoff, by Michelle A. Nott, Heather E. Driscoll, Minoru Takeda, Mahesh Vangala, Steven R. Corsi, and Scott W. Tighe; PLOS ONE, 2020, https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0227567.
